title: xdrip calibration doesn't seem to work
symptom: After calibrating on xdrip, the calibrated BG value did not have any effect on the trend; the trend remains inaccurate, as if calibration never happened.
cause: The xdrip_bubble branch may use OOP algorithm which doesn't support calibration as default.
fix: Uninstall the xdrip_bubble version and install the community branch from the Nightscout Foundation release page to enable calibration feature.
evidence_quote: the xdrip_bubble branch may make OOP algorithm which doesn’t support calibration as default. Try to uninstall the xdrip_bubble,then download the apk file from nightscoutfoundation release page.
